facts.business: Kitex Garments Limited is a fully export-oriented enterprise with an integrated yarn-to-garment manufacturing model, specializing in infant and children's apparel while extending capabilities across men's, women's and unisex categories for leading international customers in the USA and Europe.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Commercial production commenced, facility nearing completion

auditor.name: MSKA & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Standalone Financial Statements contain qualification; Consolidated Financial Statements do not contain any qualification, reservation, disclaimer or adverse remarks. Quarterly returns/statements filed with banks not in agreement with books of accounts for inventory and trade receivables.

key_risks: Quarterly returns/statements filed with banks not in agreement with books of accounts for inventory and trade receivables
Loans to subsidiaries not regular in payment of interest
Delayed disclosure of insider trading threshold breach by designated person
Fine imposed by BSE and NSE for delayed approval for appointment of Non-Executive Independent Director aged 75+
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties were on arm's length pricing basis and in ordinary course of business, approved by Audit Committee. Shareholders approved all material related party transactions for FY 25-26 at 33rd AGM held on September 17, 2025. Corporate guarantee of ₹2023 Crores given in 2023-24. Loan amount of ₹9,310.25 Lakhs made to wholly owned subsidiaries.
